pl-l2d30c7-d1e108.summary: States that many testimonies of the saints teach that original sin is fault.

pl-l2d30c7-d1e111.summary: Cites Gregory on Exodus 'the firstborn of an ass you shall exchange for a sheep': all born in sins and conceived from the pleasure of the flesh contract original fault, and so are entangled in sins by our will. So original sin is fault.

pl-l2d30c7-d1e116.summary: Cites De natura et gratia: all have sinned, in themselves or in Adam, either by what they contracted originally or added by bad conduct; the first man's sin harmed the whole race, from which we received both condemnation and fault.
claims: From Adam we received condemnation and fault.

pl-l2d30c7-d1e120.summary: Cites Augustine on Psalm 50: what is sown from a dead body is born with the bond of original sin and death.
claims: Birth carries the bond of original sin.

pl-l2d30c7-d1e123.summary: Explains David says he was conceived in iniquities because iniquity and the bond of death are drawn from Adam in all; no one is born without punishment and the merit of punishment, which is sin; so all born through concupiscence contract sin, and original sin is fault.
claims: The merit of punishment is sin.
Original sin is fault contracted through concupiscent conception.

pl-l2d30c7-d1e126.summary: Cites the Ecclesiastical Dogmas: hold most firmly that everyone conceived by intercourse of man and woman is born with original sin, subject to impiety and death, by nature a child of wrath, from which only faith in the Mediator frees.
claims: All conceived by intercourse are born with original sin.

pl-l2d30c7-d1e129.summary: Concludes that original sin is fault and is contracted from parents by all begotten through concupiscence.
claims: Original sin is fault contracted from parents.

pl-l2d30c7.summary: Shows from many authorities that original sin is fault. Gregory: all born in sins and conceived from the pleasure of the flesh contract original fault. Augustine: all sinned, either in themselves or in Adam; from him we received both condemnation and fault; what is sown from a dead body is born with the bond of original sin and death; no one is born without punishment and the merit of punishment, which is sin. The Ecclesiastical Dogmas: everyone conceived by intercourse is born with original sin, a child of wrath, freed only by faith in the Mediator. So original sin is fault, contracted from parents by all begotten through concupiscence.
claims: Original sin is fault, not merely liability.
All are conceived in sins and contract original fault.
From Adam we receive both condemnation and fault.
No one is born without punishment and the merit of punishment.
Everyone conceived through intercourse is born with original sin.
Only faith in the Mediator frees from original sin.
